exercises.title: Preflight: claude / java / mvnw versions
exercises.pedagogy: Toolchain smoke — confirms Claude Code, Java 21, Maven wrapper are all on PATH and respond. Exit-code-only via `verify.sh`.

exercises.title: Fix the N+1 in OrderService.getRecentOrders (no CLAUDE.md)
exercises.pedagogy: First N+1 fix WITHOUT CLAUDE.md context. Learner experiences raw Claude on Spring Boot, watches it propose @EntityGraph or JOIN FETCH, sees the canonical fix land. The pain motivates M2's CLAUDE.md authoring.

exercises.title: Retry the N+1 fix — now with team-conventions CLAUDE.md
exercises.pedagogy: Same N+1 fix, but starter branch carries a production-grade CLAUDE.md. Learner sees Claude reach for Testcontainers + canonical patterns without prompting. Reuses exercise-01's hidden test — only the SUT context differs.

exercises.title: Author /controller-review slash command
exercises.assertion: .claude/commands/controller-review.md exists, uses $ARGUMENTS, has >= 4 H2 audit sections
exercises.pedagogy: Reusable slash command for code audit. Tests the learner's ability to package a Claude prompt into a parameterized command artifact.

exercises.title: Build mockito-test-writer subagent
exercises.assertion: .claude/agents/mockito-test-writer.md has frontmatter (name/description/tools), body references MockitoExtension + jakarta
exercises.pedagogy: Custom Claude subagent that delegates test-authoring with Spring conventions. Tests the learner's understanding of subagent YAML + system-prompt scope.

exercises.title: Wire three hooks in .claude/settings.json
exercises.assertion: .claude/settings.json has 3 hooks: PreToolUse blocker for application-prod.properties, PreToolUse spotless:apply on Edit *.java, PostToolUse mvnw test on Edit *.java
exercises.pedagogy: Hooks contract — JSON shape + matcher patterns + execution semantics. The verify script asserts shape AND fires each hook to confirm the command-string actually runs.

exercises.title: Wire the team-tickets MCP server
exercises.assertion: claude mcp list --json shows team-tickets MCP connected with >= 1 tool registered
exercises.pedagogy: Real MCP server consumption — clone server, configure transport, verify connection. Uses the language-agnostic aie-team-tickets-mcp.

exercises.title: Capstone: implement OrdersController + integration test
exercises.assertion: POST /orders returns 201 on happy path; 400 on missing field with errors[]; idempotency-key returns same body on repeat
exercises.pedagogy: Full controller + integration test pair. Tests @Valid validation, Idempotency-Key header handling, HTTP status codes. Capstone composability.

migration_notes.phase_1_2026_04_28: manifest committed; branch_current preserved (module-N-<theme>). LMS reads branch_current.
migration_notes.phase_2_branch_rename: Coordinated rename: branch_current -> branch_target. One PR per repo per Opus's direction. Update CourseAsset.module_branches to point at branch_target.
migration_notes.phase_3_lms_step_replacement: Replace existing terminal_exercise steps with new hands_on steps that reference {course, nn, slug}. Step's grading dispatch reads this manifest.
migration_notes.phase_4_extend: Add exercise/05-investigate-vague-symptom (concurrency), exercise/06-tests-from-scratch, exercise/07-migration (RFC 7807 Problem Detail), exercise/08-when-not-to-use-claude — pedagogy from inspiration repo.

contract.result_protocol: stdout final line == 'RESULT: PASS' OR 'RESULT: FAIL'; failing tests preceded by 'FAILED: <test_name> - <message>' lines
contract.machine_readable: grading-result.json written to repo root with {exercise, status, total, passed, failures, errors, skipped, exitCode, timestamp}
contract.test_runner_specific_files: scripts/parse-<runner>.sh; for jspring this is parse-surefire.sh
